comment: The maker's README has no instructions for this module: its section reads COMING SOON, so the lines here come from the source and the panel. The module has sixteen outputs and no EOC or EOR jack, yet the 'EOC pulse from' submenu is still built (KeySampler.cpp around :4714) with nothing to send a pulse to; it is left out of the lines for that reason. 'Trim Sample after Save' and 'Save Oversampled' are added twice on the module's own menu, once inside the sample block and once outside it (:4666-4667). All eight slots share one set of panel controls, switched by the SLOT knob, so a knob shows the value belonging to the selected slot and not a fixed setting. The waveform display is a custom widget with no ParamWidget, so its own menu — which carries Reset Cursors, Copy Cue to Loop and Copy Loop to Cue — cannot be reached by clicking it for help, and Reset Cursors is commented out on the module's own menu.
